text.p: Struggling German first division side Hamburg have sacked their trainer Felix Magath.
"I've been told that from tomorrow I'm no longer Hamburg coach," Magath told the television sports channel DSF on Sunday night.
The former Germany striker arrived at Hamburg in October 1995 after Uwe Seeler took over as club chairman.

Magath promptly steered Hamburg out of the relegation zone and led them to a UEFA Cup berth, establishing a reputation as a hard taskmaster and disciplinarian along the way and extending his initial contract until 1999.
But Hamburg's league form this season has been poor and a dismal 4-0 home defeat to Cologne on Saturday left them in 15th place, one above the relegation zone.
